title: alnus fruticosa var. typica
intro: Alnus fruticosa var. typica, commonly known as the Green Alder, is a deciduous shrub or small tree found in the mountainous regions of Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against infections, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alnus fruticosa var. typica include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
